note: Moves pinConversionGoal, buildConversionWatcher and window helpers out of the executor service into a new conversion-watcher.ts module.
Replaces parallel offsets/messages vectors in Group with a single Vec<GroupMessage> pairing each offset with its message.
Uses has_engine_seq(table) in the shadow buffer guard, reads restart_seq by CDC_SEQ_COLUMN name, and drops the stale last-column comment.
Replaces the hand-copied write tool list with flag_write_tools(), deriving names from generated-tool-definitions.json by category and readOnlyHint false.
v2 version race now raises Conflict(flag_version_conflict_message(token, locked_version)), plus other unrelated v2 review fixes.
Extracts per-partition stamping into BatchPartition::record, which restarts the ledger slice on generation change, with unit tests for the mid-batch regain case.
Deletes the repair command entirely, removing the divergent direct detect_config_format call, but adds no shared is_v1_config predicate.
Drops actionsModel connection from insightVizDataLogic, reads it via findMounted, and mounts actionsModel in TaxonomicBreakdownPopover.
Removes the inline MAX_TXN_OPS const; put_freeze_acks takes max_txn_ops as a parameter wired through leader and router config.
Moves websiteMetricsMetricCardTemplate.ts from frontend/src into products/dashboards/frontend and updates the import in newDashboardLogic.
_lookup_location now returns a frozen kw_only CachedLocation dataclass instead of a tuple; caller reads named fields.
Uses EmailLookupHandler.users_matching_email for the email holder check and for the pending email promotion check in verify_email.
Renames arm to branch in config.py docstrings, ConfigFormatError, rules.py, and the test_facade test name.
_is_feature_flag_config_input now derives config keys from ExperimentFeatureFlagInputSerializer().fields instead of a hardcoded tuple.
Adds get_members_to_notify_of_matview_failure that intersects two get_members_to_notify calls; digest and immediate senders use it.
Adds showStartupCap (and showStartupCapLine) selectors to visionQuotaLogic and switches the three components to them.
Moves REGEX_BACKTRACK_LIMIT from property_matching into property_models next to CompiledRegex::new.
Adds toAccessControlLevel helper replacing all five casts, and renders AccessDenied on 403 instead of a retry banner.
Deletes the hand-built observationThumbnailUrl and uses getVisionObservationsThumbnailRetrieveUrl from the Replay Vision generated client.
Removes the ExposedCHQueryError to ValidationError conversion from the runner and wraps runner.run() in person.py instead.
